# Quick reference: operations manager

## Every day

1. Open the confirmation view at the start of the day. [SC-11 step 1]
2. Check which of yesterday's orders were confirmed. [SC-11 step 2]
3. Read stock on hand beside each line. [SC-08]
4. Treat "stock not known" as a code missing from the stock sheet. [SC-09]
5. Answer the order coordinator's questions about the exceptions list. [map/roles.md operations manager]

## When something looks wrong

An order not confirmed the day it arrived has a line on the exceptions list. [SC-04]
